note: a small body travels with its row and echoes the payload's length and mark
an empty stored body is available, never absent
a false truncation mark is not echoed
a body whose text was not read is large, sized by its stored bytes
a body whose JSON takes exactly the inline budget travels with its row
a body whose escapes take it over the budget is large, sized by the payload's length
a negative payload length is not echoed
a fractional payload length is not echoed, so a large body is sized by its stored bytes
